name: Hoxton Cabin
summary: A bar and creative hub on Kingsland Road, according to its ma.to listing, with underground stand-up comedy, karaoke, progressive house nights and open decks played on vinyl.

music.notes: Per its ma.to listing: Red Eye nights of melodic and progressive house, weekly open-decks sessions for local DJs, plus stand-up comedy and karaoke.

accessibility.notes: CAMRA's entry mentions step-free access and no accessible toilet. Some nights are held in the basement, and no source says how that space is reached.

evidence.quote: Hoxton Cabin is an inclusive London bar and creative hub featuring underground comedy, vinyl open decks, and diverse social events
Guests can explore an underground stage hosting nightly stand-up comedy, alongside vinyl-only open decks, karaoke, and progressive house nights.
Hoxton Cabin is located at 132 Kingsland Road, Shoreditch, London, E2 8DP.
Progressive and melodic house in an intimate East London cabin setting.
Celebrating four years of Red Eye with a special night of melodic house.
Weekly open deck sessions for local selectors and music lovers.
Hoxton Cabin hosts a variety of events including stand-up comedy, vinyl-only open decks, karaoke, pub quizzes, art exhibitions, and electronic music club nights.
Step free access. No Accessible toilet.
Deep music in the basement with four DJs
